aliases: Pike County AI data center campus
status_detail: Federal and project sources describe the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site in Pike County as a PORTS Technology Campus for frontier AI/data-center infrastructure plus new power generation; secondary coverage describes up to 10 GW of campus capacity.
notes: Included because federal/project-site sources identify Pike County's PORTS site as a large data center/HPC campus. Capacity_mw uses the reported 10 GW campus scale; individual building IT load was not found.

status_detail: Bitdeer announced an agreement to lease and develop a Portage County site with up to 750 MW of capacity. Local reporting places the project at/near Turnpike Commerce Center in Shalersville Township, where officials and residents have discussed moratoria and conditional-use zoning.
notes: The Bitdeer investor release intermittently timed out during link checking, so the row uses accessible industry/local/township sources. Capacity_mw follows DCD and local reporting.

status_detail: Preble County planning records describe Zoning Case #1630, a request to rezone agricultural land in Jefferson Township to allow a Computer Data Storage Center; county commission agenda later listed the case as withdrawn, and local reporting described the applicant withdrawal after public opposition.
notes: County agenda/minutes are official evidence for the rezoning case; capacity and final alternative site were not found.

project_name: Putnam County data processing and battery facility inquiry
aliases: data processing and battery facilities zoning inquiry
status_detail: County commission minutes show officials discussed whether the county should add zoning rules for data processing and battery facilities after an inquiry about such facilities. No named developer, site, permit or approval was found.
notes: Included under the brief's broad early-lead standard because county official minutes indicate a facility inquiry, but this is weak project evidence and may never have advanced.

project_name: EnergiAcres Richland County data center and power campus
aliases: Richland County data center/power plant/greenhouse project
Northern Richland County data center proposal
status_detail: EnergiAcres proposed a data center, power plant and greenhouse campus in northern Richland County/Franklin Township. Mansfield's mayor said the city would no longer pursue the project, and Richland County commissioners later declared no interest in the data-center proposal.
notes: Capacity_mw uses EnergiAcres/project-context statements about an initial half-gigawatt/500 MW power component, not confirmed IT load.

project_name: U.S. Paper Mill high-performance computing campus
developer: U.S. Paper Mill Co.; Aligned Data Centers
status_detail: U.S. Paper Mill Co. announced plans for a high-performance computing data center campus at the former Pixelle paper mill in Chillicothe, with Aligned as partner; company and local sources describe an anticipated $1.5 billion redevelopment using mill infrastructure and power assets.
notes: Capacity_mw not disclosed in accessible sources; included because company/local economic-development materials identify a named HPC/data center redevelopment.

status_detail: Local coverage indicates a potential/proposed data center on land bordering Woodville Township, Gibsonburg and Madison Township, with residents pushing back and officials discussing the proposal. Later local reporting says Gibsonburg officials were still updating residents on data-center talks.
notes: Developer and capacity were not found. Included as broad-scope lead because a named county/township location and local reporting exist, but status remains early and uncertain.

project_name: Tilted Gate Franklin Furnace data center
developer: Tilted Gate LLC; undisclosed Fortune 100 tech company
status_detail: Scioto County commissioners considered and later approved tax-abatement terms for a proposed 500,000 sq ft, $1 billion data center in the Franklin Furnace/Haverhill area. Early sources identify Tilted Gate LLC and an undisclosed Fortune 100 technology company under NDA.
notes: This replaces weaker New Boston/Aland phrasing with the better-supported Franklin Furnace/Haverhill/Tilted Gate lead. Capacity_mw not disclosed.

status_detail: No commercial, colocation, hyperscale, AI/HPC or server-farm project was found in Seneca County official, EDA, planning, or local-news searches.
notes: Searches surfaced county internal IT/server-room references and unrelated Ohio data center activity in other counties; these were not counted as projects.

aliases: Northwest Data Operations LLC Project Galaxy
developer: Northwest Data Operations LLC; Amazon Web Services
status_detail: Sidney's official data center FAQ describes Project Galaxy as a data center campus by Northwest Data Operations LLC, a subsidiary of Amazon Web Services. City council approved enterprise-zone/tax-increment agreements in December 2025 and a grading permit was approved on May 14, 2026 for Phase 1 site work.
notes: No MW capacity found in city materials. Status marked construction because the city FAQ reports an approved grading permit for initial phase work.
